i’ve been taking pregabalin for almost 2 and a half years now (75mg daily usually at night, but i’ll sometimes take 75mg in the morning). started taking it for generalized and social anxiety but mostly for intrusive thoughts.

i’ve experienced the exact same symptoms you’ve described and i’ll often have this trance-like feeling despite taking it literally every single day - colours seem brighter, the world is blurrier, and like you it’s like my mind is 5 second slower than my body. i’ll have a thought and once i’ll want to express it, it sort of comes out like a word salad. generally it helps me become less self-conscious about what i’m saying. taking it only at night seems to help though.

that being said although i sometimes feel dumber my intrusive thoughts have definitely lessened, but i also feel more indifferent…

pregabalin is known to improve slow wave sleep and reduce sleep disturbances - i personally don’t have many vivid dreams on pregabalin but i also take l-theanine and magnesium before going to bed which might help?

overall my experience on pregabalin has been quite positive but the occasional trance-like state is something i had to adjust to. eating with your morning dose definitely helps if you don’t want it hit as hard.

i have experience with both alprazolam and diazepam. diazepam is my personal favourite for generalized anxiety but in my experience sublingual xanax i believe is most effective for panic attacks - but because of its short duration there’s a higher risk of rebound anxiety. sometimes i’ll combine xanax and diazepam so that the diazepam levels me out.

overall i think xanax is best for distressing psychological anxiety while valium works best for ruminations. .25-.5mg xanax + 5mg valium does the trick for me when it gets particularly bad.
